title: With a stellar QB draft class in 2027 coming, will we see NBA-level tanking from any NFL teams?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: With a stellar QB draft class in 2027 coming, will we see NBA-level tanking from any NFL teams?
sources.description: No other position in sports moves the needle like QB. And the best way to get one is to draft very high. And the easiest way to pull that off is to lose a lot of games.
